# Carbon v0.1.18

## Fixed

- **Bare-acrylic beat on reopen further reduced** — warm windows no longer natively hide: invisibility now comes from the DWM cloak plus an off-screen park, so the swapchain stays alive and there is no hide/show cold-present transition. Reveals move back on-screen (overlay from the cursor, main from its saved position) and uncloak through the paint gate. Parked windows stay out of the taskbar and Alt-Tab.
- **Rare mid-session white flash hardened** — DWM ordering flushes after the final show-path cloaks, physical cloak verification at every painted-ack with alpha-snap recovery, and adaptive stale-settle holds (overlay 40ms, main 50ms when stale) so a long-idle-throttled renderer resumes presenting before the reveal ramp. Warm opens pay zero added latency.
- **Long-idle overlay surface decay** — the overlay gets the same 45s background keep-warm loop as main, a show-path re-present when stale, and overlay-aware present-cycle race guards (a racing cycle bails instead of parking over a live show).
- **Snippet engine wedge fixed** — the first engine-driven placement pill re-locked the expansion mutex on its own thread and froze the whole app. The pill path is now snapshot-and-drop lock-free.
- **Placement-confirmation pill popup removed** — it rendered as an empty gray slab instead of its message. Success is still confirmed by the in-overlay/in-library toasts and the paste itself.
- **Twin painted-acks could double-run the uncloak** — per-window serialization plus re-validation makes uncloak exactly-once per show.

## Changed

- Paint/cloak/hide/recovery IPC commands are async; blocking uncloak work runs under spawn_blocking.
- Single prewarm pass at boot (duplicate spawn removed).
- Suite now covers parked-hide chrome, async uncloak ordering, overlay warmth/rewarm/settle, pill suppression, and the no-relock discipline (158 JS + 52 Rust tests green).

## Updating

- **On v0.1.17:** the in-app updater picks this release up automatically.
- **On v0.1.16 or earlier:** the updater signing key was rotated with v0.1.17, so install this one manually once — download `Carbon_0.1.18_x64-setup.exe` below and run it. Automatic in-app updates resume from v0.1.18 onward.
